thread:
mike: Hi all — first day 🎉. Just unboxed the M2 Air. Trying to enroll in Kandji but the MDM profile keeps failing after FileVault prompts. Also need Rosetta for an x86-only CLI tool. Anyone who handles enroll + short-lived admin?

it-support: welcome! quick checklist: did you see the "Company Device Enrollment" profile in System Settings -> Profiles? And what did the FileVault prompt say?

mike: I get a macOS dialog: "Enable FileVault to continue enrollment" then after consenting it reboots and shows: "Enrollment failed: escrow failed (0xE003)". Also the app I need is x86; terminal says: `arch -x86_64 /bin/bash -c 'which python'` returns nothing.

kandji-bot: Device serial: XYZ9876LMNO matched to "new-hires-dev" blueprint. Enrollment status: partial. FileVault escrow failure code E003. Rosetta not installed (Apple Silicon required).

security: @mike are you on corp Wi-Fi (redwood-internal) or a guest network? escrow requires connectivity to our KMS endpoint during first boot.

mike: on the office Wi-Fi "redwood-5g" — same SSID I used during setup. No VPN.

it-support: sounds like a transient escrow issue. Two safe options: (1) We can trigger remote escrow retry once you’re on wired or corp Wi-Fi and re-run `sudo fdesetup status` and `profiles show -type enrollment`. (2) If you need Rosetta first, we can grant temp local admin for 48h to install Rosetta and the vendor tool; we’ll audit the session. Which do you prefer?

mike: need Rosetta for the build tools ASAP. Also want to avoid re-doing enrollment steps multiple times. temp admin ok if it won’t cancel the enrollment flow.

it-support: Ok. We usually grant a constrained local admin that preserves MDM enrollment flow. Conditions: 48h, no SIP changes, KEXTs blocked by default. To request, post the device serial + manager approval in #help. Please include a photo of the asset sticker.

team-lead: I approve — mike is doing first-week hardware bringup for infra. @it-support, go ahead.

it-support: noted. @devops will provision the admin and DM creds. While that happens, run these and paste outputs: ```sudo fdesetup status``` and ```profiles show -type enrollment | grep -A2 "Status"```

mike: running:
```
$ sudo fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
$ profiles show -type enrollment | grep -A2 "Status"
    Status: Attempting Enrollment
    Last check-in: 2026-03-15 08:12:01 +0000
```

kandji-bot: Re-scan queued. Note: escrow endpoint temporarily rate-limited for your subnet earlier (maintenance window). If enrollment doesn't finalize after rescans, IT will perform manual escrow.

devops: admin creds DM'd to @mike. username: temp-mike-48h. Please do not change password. We log sudo sessions.

mike: got creds, installing Rosetta with `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. Installer says success. Installed vendor tool (x86) via `arch -x86_64 /usr/local/bin/install-tool`.

it-support: good — did enrollment finalize after the install/reboot?

mike: I rebooted once; `profiles show` now says "Status: Enrolled" and kandji shows device compliant. fdesetup still says FileVault is On and `fdesetup list` shows escrowed users.

security: tagging for the audit: @it-support please ensure the audit log includes the install steps and that no kernel extensions were loaded. We require the session transcript attached to the ticket.

it-support: will collect logs at revoke. @mike one small note: the vendor tool used a udev-like kernel helper? any prompts about "system extensions"?

mike: none, tool used userspace USB lib. No KEXT approvals requested.

devops: reminder: temporary admin will auto-expire at 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z. We will run a compliance check and rotate the local account right after.

mike: perfect — everything I need works. Enrollment completed. thanks! 🙂

team-lead: welcome again, @mike. ping me if you need access to the hardware bench or serial consoles.

security: for docs — we'll add a short FAQ about Rosetta+enrollment edge cases so future new-hires see this flow.

mike: awesome, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
